SELECT C.CALENDER_NO AS calenderNo, C.TITLE AS title, TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDate, TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS startTime, TO_CHAR(C.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS endDate, TO_CHAR(C.END_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS endTime FROM CALENDER C INNER JOIN CALENDERMEMBER CM ON C.CALENDER_NO = CM.CALENDER_NO INNER JOIN USERS U ON CM.USER_NO = U.USER_NO WHERE U.COMPANY_NO = #{companyNo} AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '활성' AND C.DISCLOSURE_STATUS = '1' AND NVL(C.IS_DELETED, 'N') = 'N'
AND C.START_DATE < ADD_MONTHS( TO_DATE(#{year} || LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), 'YYYYMM'), 1 ) AND C.END_DATE >= TO_DATE( #{year} || LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), 'YYYYMM' )
GROUP BY C.CALENDER_NO, C.TITLE, C.START_DATE, C.END_DATE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CM.USER_NO) = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE COMPANY_NO = #{companyNo} AND ACCOUNT_STATUS = '활성' ) ORDER BY C.START_DATE

SELECT C.CALENDER_NO AS calenderNo, C.TITLE AS title, C.CONTENT AS content, TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDate, TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS startTime, TO_CHAR(C.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS endDate, TO_CHAR(C.END_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS endTime, U.USER_NAME AS creatorName, CO.COMPANY_NAME AS companyName FROM CALENDER C LEFT JOIN CALENDERCONNECTION CC ON C.CALENDER_NO = CC.CALENDER_NO LEFT JOIN USERS U ON CC.USER_NO = U.USER_NO LEFT JOIN COMPANY CO ON U.COMPANY_NO = CO.COMPANY_NO WHERE C.CALENDER_NO = #{calenderNo} AND NVL(C.IS_DELETED, 'N') = 'N' AND ROWNUM = 1

mapper.update: UPDATE CALENDER SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, START_DATE = TO_DATE(#{startDate} || ' ' || #{startTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), END_DATE = TO_DATE(#{endDate} || ' ' || #{endTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') WHERE CALENDER_NO = #{calenderNo}
